entry.title: SteamOS 0.5.7 Beta for Steam Frame
entry.summary:
SteamOS 0.5.7 (for Steam Frame) has just been released. This update is for the Steam Frame Beta channel, and includes new features that are still being tested. You can opt into this in Settings > System > System Update Channel.
SteamVR:
SteamVR has been updated to version 2.19.1
Improved vibration filtering for pose prediction that was affecting some units
The display dims for 30 seconds before sleep
Foveated sharpening is now independent from Eye Tracking (previously would disable when off, now defaults to centered)
Removed Advanced Supersampling support on Steam Frame
The guided tour keeps Steam docked front and center
Frame Controllers:
Battery now shows correctly at 0%
Added default bindings for Chromalab, Batman Arkham, and Doom VFR
OS:
Enable support for WebXR in Chromium 157 & up
Audio:
Fixed an issue where audio would stop working with USB or Bluetooth speakers if an application tried to access the microphone
Added controls to selectively disable echo cancellation and noise suppression for the microphone (requires current Steam Client Beta)
You can opt into the Steam Client Beta on headset via Settings > System > Steam Client Update Channel.
